item.title: 53 Women Out Here Slaying Jobs That Require Skill Over Style
item.description: Professional women are supposed to be judged by their skills and achievements, but appearance often steals the spotlight. From surgeons and firefighters to chefs and scientists, many skip manicures and pedicures because practicality, safety, and hygiene come first. Yet societal pressures still demand "polished" looks, creating a constant balancing act. The full story behind these career-driven choices, and what they reveal about beauty, work, and empowerment, is in the article.

item.title: Dolls Revealed: Faces Without Makeup Repainted Realistically
item.description: Unrealistic portrayal of dolls and its effect on female self-image is a persistent discussion surrounding the toy industry. Dolls were, and in most cases still are, an ideal of proportional body shape and beauty which has been influencing girls around the world from the very young age. This perfectly symmetrical and flawless image has become an aspiration, though it‘s far from realistic.
